**Indications and Usage:**
1. Uses reduces underarm wetness

**Purpose/Uses:**
1. Purpose antiperspirant

**Description:**
1. DEGREE ADVANCED FRESH ENGLISH ROSE 72H ANTIPERSPIRANT DEODORANT - aluminum Sesquichlorohydrate stick

**Warnings:**
1. Warnings • For external use only. • Do not use on broken skin . • Ask a doctor before use if you have kidney disease. • Stop use if rash or irritation occurs.

**Dosage and Administration:**
1. Directions apply to underarms only
